verdicts.tldr: a treasury reason is escaped once when the proposal is created and stored, and the stored text is rendered raw, so a reason stored before the upgrade keeps a bare `$` that still opens math; no proposal on gnoland-1 holds one today
verdicts.details: Deployed on gnoland-1: prop_requests.gno:248 runs sanitize.InlineText on the reason inside NewTreasuryPaymentRequest, sanitize.gno:349 calls the chain/markdown native, and render.gno:124 appends p.Description() as stored. The native ships with the binary, so an in-place upgrade escapes new reasons only. Latent: every one of the 16 proposals renders a single `$`, the one in its vote links.
verdicts.evidence: qfile: prop_requests.gno:248 `safeReason := sanitize.InlineText(...)`; sanitize.gno:349 `return markdown.EscapeInline(s)`; render.gno:124 `out += p.Description()`. qrender gno.land/r/gov/dao:0..15: dollars=1 on each, `/r/gov/dao$help&func=MustVoteOnProposalSimple`.
